variations.name: Central ducted & mini-split air-source heat pumps (incl. hybrid/dual-fuel)
variations.description: Inverter-driven vapor-compression units that move heat between outdoor air and the home through ducts or wall-mounted heads, replacing a gas furnace plus AC with one electric appliance — the single biggest lever for residential building decarbonization.

companies.name: Daikin
companies.what: World's largest HVAC maker (incl. Goodman/Amana in the US); compact ducted 'Fit' inverter systems and the global champion of R32, with royalty-free patent pledges
companies.signal: ~$30B+ annual HVAC revenue; heat pumps designated core growth business

companies.name: Mitsubishi Electric
companies.what: Mini-split pioneer; Hyper-Heat (H2i) lines and the intelli-HEAT dual-fuel A-coil that converts existing gas furnaces into hybrid heat-pump systems; US JV with Trane (METUS)
companies.signal: De-facto standard ductless brand in the US Northeast

companies.name: Carrier
companies.what: Infinity variable-speed ducted heat pumps; bet the portfolio on home electrification by buying Viessmann Climate Solutions for ~€12B (closed Jan 2024)
companies.signal: ~$22B revenue; Viessmann deal was the largest-ever heat pump acquisition

companies.name: Trane Technologies
companies.what: XV-series variable-speed residential heat pumps plus the largest commercial electrification install base in North America
companies.signal: ~$20B revenue, climate pure-play since 2020 spinoff

companies.name: Lennox
companies.what: SL25XPV flagship (first DOE Cold Climate Heat Pump Challenge unit to market) and a 2024 North America JV with Samsung for ductless/mini-split
companies.signal: NYSE: LII, ~$5B revenue

companies.name: Bosch Home Comfort
companies.what: IDS inverter ducted heat pumps; vaulted into the global top tier by buying Johnson Controls' residential/light-commercial HVAC plus the JCI-Hitachi JV (York, Coleman, Hitachi brands)
companies.signal: $8B acquisition closed Jul 31, 2025 — Bosch's largest ever; 33 plants post-deal

companies.name: Midea
companies.what: World's largest AC and compressor manufacturer; launched the EVOX G³ cold-climate ducted heat pump platform for North America and OEMs for many western brands
companies.signal: ~$50B+ revenue appliance/HVAC group

companies.name: Gree
companies.what: One of the two largest air conditioner and heat pump manufacturers on earth by volume; major OEM behind western-branded mini-splits
companies.signal: Tens of millions of units/year from Zhuhai-based plants

companies.name: Quilt
companies.what: Vertically integrated 'Nest-style' mini-split system — flush wall heads, room-level smart controls, in-house design and managed installation
companies.signal: $20M Series B Dec 2025 (Energy Impact Partners + Galvanize; $64M total); ~1,000 units across 16 US states and 5 Canadian provinces

variations.name: Air-to-water hydronic heat pumps
variations.description: Heat pumps that produce hot (and chilled) water for radiators, underfloor loops, and fan coils, letting the world's boiler-heated housing stock electrify without ripping out emitters — the dominant heat pump form factor in Europe.

companies.name: Vaillant
companies.what: aroTHERM plus R290 monobloc (75°C flow) is Europe's benchmark air-to-water unit; dedicated heat pump megafactory in Senica, Slovakia
companies.signal: Among top-3 European heat pump producers by volume

companies.name: Viessmann Climate Solutions
companies.what: Vitocal 250/252 R290 air-to-water family; the German champion sold to Carrier in the sector's landmark consolidation
companies.signal: Acquired by Carrier for ~€12B (closed Jan 2024); continues operating as Carrier's European heat pump arm

companies.name: NIBE Industrier
companies.what: Nordic heat pump group; S2125 R290 air-to-water line; bellwether for the European market's 2023-24 slump and subsequent recovery
companies.signal: Stockholm-listed; cut ~500 jobs in 2024 downturn, demand recovering since

companies.name: Daikin Europe
companies.what: Altherma air-to-water family; European heat pump market leader with dedicated EU factories (Belgium, Czechia, Poland)
companies.signal: Multi-billion-euro EU heat pump investment program

companies.name: Stiebel Eltron
companies.what: German specialist in air-to-water heat pumps and integrated ventilation/heat-pump systems for low-energy homes
companies.signal: Family-owned, >€1B revenue, heat-pump-led growth

companies.name: Aira
companies.what: Direct-to-consumer brand selling its own R290 air-to-water unit (built in Wrocław, Poland) with in-house installer academies and a monthly subscription model
companies.signal: €150M equity Aug 2025 (Altor, Kinnevik, Temasek et al.); €200M sales run-rate, 1,200 employees across UK/Germany/Italy

companies.name: Octopus Energy
companies.what: UK energy retailer that designed and manufactures its own Cosy 6 R290 heat pump, bundling installs with smart time-of-use tariffs
companies.signal: One of the UK's fastest-growing heat pump installers; Octopus group valued ~$9B

companies.name: Harvest Thermal
companies.what: US system pairing a CO2 (SANCO2) heat pump water heater with a thermal-storage tank and 'Pod' controller to run home space + water heating on cheap off-peak power
companies.signal: TIME America's Top GreenTech list 2024 and 2025; opened its controls platform ('Harvest Open') to third-party heat pumps mid-2025

variations.white_space: Air-to-water is mature in Europe but nearly absent from US distribution despite millions of US hydronic and steam-heated homes — an opening for UL-listed high-temp monoblocs and storage-integrated hydronic packages.

variations.name: Cold-climate heat pumps
variations.description: Units with vapor-injection compressors, enhanced-capacity refrigerant circuits, and smarter defrost that hold rated heating output at -15°C to -30°C, killing the 'heat pumps don't work in winter' objection in northern markets.

companies.name: Mitsubishi Electric (METUS)
companies.what: Hyper-Heat H2i delivers 100% heating capacity at 5°F and operates to about -13°F; the reference product for US cold-climate installs
companies.signal: Decades of cold-climate field data; dominant in New England/Canada retrofits

companies.name: Lennox
companies.what: SL25XPV — the first DOE Cold Climate Heat Pump Challenge prototype to reach commercial sale (2023)
companies.signal: DOE CCHP Challenge graduate, commercialized ahead of all eight participating OEMs

companies.name: Trane
companies.what: DOE CCHP Challenge partner field-testing and commercializing cold-climate ducted units with utility partners
companies.signal: CCHP Challenge prototypes validated in northern-state field trials

companies.name: Midea
companies.what: EVOX G³ ducted cold-climate system rated to operate down to roughly -22°F at mass-market prices
companies.signal: DOE CCHP Challenge participant; leverages world's largest compressor supply chain

companies.name: Bosch Home Comfort
companies.what: IDS Ultra cold-climate ducted heat pump heating to -13°F without resistance backup
companies.signal: Launched 2024 as Bosch's North America cold-climate flagship

companies.name: Fujitsu General
companies.what: Airstage extra-low-temperature mini-splits long used in Nordic and Hokkaido markets
companies.signal: Decades of sub-zero ductless deployments

variations.name: Window, room & portable packaged heat pumps (120V saddle units)
variations.description: Self-contained plug-in heat pumps that hang over a window sill or slot through a wall on a standard 120V outlet, letting renters and aging multifamily buildings electrify apartment-by-apartment with no ductwork, refrigerant work, or panel upgrades.

companies.name: Gradient
companies.what: Purpose-built saddle-style 120V cold-climate window heat pump that preserves window light/egress; co-winner of NYCHA's Clean Heat for All Challenge with a 10,000-unit contract
companies.signal: NYSERDA-backed; NYCHA large-scale deployment slowed during evaluation and 2025 China-tariff pressure, though the 10,000-unit contract remains in effect

companies.name: Midea
companies.what: Packaged Window Heat Pump: 120V saddle unit delivering 100% heating at 5°F; anchor supplier for NYCHA's 20,000-unit Clean Heat for All contract
companies.signal: First full-building NYCHA retrofit (Woodside Houses, Queens) completed 2025; 5,000 more purchased; consumer sales launched at ~$2,800-3,000/unit

companies.name: Friedrich
companies.what: Legacy US room-AC maker selling reverse-cycle window and through-wall heat pump units into the multifamily replacement channel
companies.signal: Century-old brand with national distribution

companies.name: LG Electronics
companies.what: Inverter PTAC/through-wall and room heat pump units for apartments and hospitality
companies.signal: Global top-5 room AC manufacturer

companies.name: Ephoca
companies.what: Italian all-in-one through-wall packaged heat pumps (AIO) with no outdoor unit, distributed in North America for room-by-room electrification
companies.signal: Niche but growing US distribution via passive-house channels

variations.white_space: Only one venture pure-play (Gradient) exists and its flagship NYCHA rollout has already slowed while Midea's manufacturing scale sets a ~$3k price floor; the opening is a sub-$2,000 saddle unit, tariff-proof domestic assembly, and a landlord/MDU sales channel — the prize is millions of US steam-heated apartments.

variations.name: Commercial rooftop unit (RTU) heat pumps & VRF/VRV systems
variations.description: Packaged rooftop heat pumps and variable-refrigerant-flow systems that electrify the gas-heated boxes conditioning roughly half of US commercial floor area and provide zoned heat recovery in large buildings.

companies.name: AAON
companies.what: Premium configurable RTUs with heat-pump and efficiency options far above code minimums; semi-custom approach makes it the electrification leader in packaged rooftops
companies.signal: NASDAQ: AAON, ~$1.2B revenue and growing data-center cooling arm (BASX)

companies.name: Daikin Applied
companies.what: Invented VRV/VRF in 1982 and sells the Rebel/Rebel Applied high-efficiency heat pump RTU lines in North America
companies.signal: Global VRF market leader

companies.name: Trane
companies.what: Voyager/Precedent heat-pump RTUs; DOE Commercial Building Heat Pump Accelerator participant developing cold-climate HP RTUs with Symbio controls
companies.signal: DOE accelerator prototypes entered national-lab validation by June 2025, targeting commercial units by Dec 2027

companies.name: Carrier
companies.what: WeatherExpert high-efficiency heat pump RTUs and a DOE accelerator participant for cold-climate rooftop heat pumps
companies.signal: Largest US RTU installed base alongside Trane/Lennox

companies.name: LG Electronics
companies.what: Multi V VRF platform pushing all-electric heat-recovery systems for mid/high-rise commercial buildings
companies.signal: Top-3 global VRF vendor

companies.name: Samsung HVAC
companies.what: DVM S2 VRF systems; formed a 2024 North America joint venture with Lennox to scale ductless and VRF distribution
companies.signal: Samsung-Lennox JV operational since 2024

variations.white_space: Essentially zero startups: AHRI certification, dealer networks, and rooftop curb standards are incumbent moats — the opening is drop-in, curb-compatible cold-climate heat pump RTUs and gas-RTU retrofit kits, which is exactly what DOE's accelerator is trying to pull from incumbents by 2027.

variations.name: High-temperature heat pumps for boiler & steam-system replacement
variations.description: Air-source units producing 70-90°C water so radiator- and steam-heated buildings can drop gas boilers without replacing emitters or repiping — the key to electrifying pre-war urban housing stock.

companies.name: Daikin
companies.what: Altherma 3 H HT delivers 70°C flow at -15°C ambient, marketed explicitly as a drop-in boiler replacement for existing radiators
companies.signal: Sold at volume across European boiler-swap programs

companies.name: OCHSNER
companies.what: Austrian high-temperature specialist; AIR HAWK and commercial series reach ~75°C+ for legacy hydronic buildings
companies.signal: Four decades of high-temp heat pump engineering

companies.name: Lambda Wärmepumpen
companies.what: Austrian R290 units with patented eZeta injection cycle posting some of Europe's highest measured SCOPs at 65-70°C flow for radiator homes
companies.signal: Top of independent efficiency rankings (e.g. HTW Berlin tests); expanding DACH production

companies.name: Mitsubishi Electric
companies.what: QAHV CO2 (R744) heat pump producing 90°C water, used to replace gas boilers in commercial and multifamily hot-water/hydronic loops
companies.signal: Deployed in US/UK commercial electrification projects

companies.name: Kelvin (formerly Radiator Labs)
companies.what: Brooklyn startup electrifying NYC steam buildings incrementally — Cozy smart radiator covers plus heat pumps and thermal storage ('hybrid electrification') claiming 60-80% of space heat electrified at ~20% of full-retrofit cost
companies.signal: $30M Series A (2022); NYSERDA-validated 25.5% average heating savings; hybrid system targeted commercial readiness ~2025

variations.white_space: US steam and pre-war hydronic multifamily has almost no UL-listed high-temperature ASHP options — Europe's 70-75°C R290 monoblocs haven't crossed the Atlantic — leaving Kelvin nearly alone against tens of thousands of NYC-style steam buildings facing Local Law 97-type emissions fines.

variations.name: Natural & low-GWP refrigerant heat pumps (R290, CO2, R32/R454B)
variations.description: Heat pumps charged with propane (GWP ~3), CO2, or lower-GWP HFO blends to eliminate the refrigerant half of HVAC's climate impact as the EU F-gas regulation and US AIM Act squeeze HFCs out.

companies.name: Vaillant
companies.what: Bet its flagship aroTHERM plus line on R290 propane, proving natural refrigerants can lead the mass market while enabling 75°C flow temperatures
companies.signal: R290 monoblocs now the best-selling architecture in several EU markets

companies.name: NIBE
companies.what: S2125 and successors moved NIBE's core air-to-water range to R290 ahead of F-gas deadlines
companies.signal: R290 across new Nordic product generations

companies.name: Wolf
companies.what: German maker whose CHA-Monoblock was an early mainstream R290 air-to-water unit
companies.signal: R290 monobloc shipping at volume since 2020

companies.name: Carrier
companies.what: Led the US residential transition to R454B ('Puron Advance') across heat pump and AC lines under the AIM Act's 2025 changeover
companies.signal: 2025 industry-wide R454B transition (with a telling refrigerant-cylinder shortage) completed across US majors

companies.name: Octopus Energy
companies.what: Cosy 6 designed in-house around R290 from day one, paired with installer training to handle A3 flammable-refrigerant rules
companies.signal: Thousands of UK installs under government BUS grants

companies.name: Midea
companies.what: Ships R290 monobloc air-to-water units into Europe and supplies R290-ready compressors at the largest scale of any manufacturer
companies.signal: World's largest compressor maker tooling for natural refrigerants

variations.white_space: US codes and UL listings still largely block A3 (flammable) refrigerants indoors, so R290 — Europe's winning answer — has no US residential foothold; first movers on US-listed R290 packaged/monobloc designs (charge kept outdoors or hermetically small, e.g. window units) get a multi-year head start when rules loosen.

variations.name: Thermally driven & gas-absorption heat pumps
variations.description: Heat pumps driven by gas combustion or engine shaft power (ammonia-water absorption, gas-engine vapor compression) that deliver 130-160% of fuel heating value — a transitional niche for buildings whose grids, panels, or budgets can't yet support full electrification.

companies.name: Stone Mountain Technologies (SMTI)
companies.what: Anesi ammonia-absorption gas heat pump (~140% AFUE, propane or natural gas) for homes and light commercial — the main new North American entrant
companies.signal: Commercially available since Feb 2024; expanding rep network 2025 (A to Z Sales midwest, BSAL Atlantic Canada); championed by the propane industry

companies.name: Robur
companies.what: Italian manufacturer selling commercial gas-absorption heat pumps (GAHP) for decades, the established European supplier in the niche
companies.signal: Long-running commercial product line

companies.name: Yanmar Energy System
companies.what: Gas-engine heat pumps (GHP) widely deployed in Japanese commercial buildings to shave peak electric demand
companies.signal: Hundreds of thousands of GHP units installed in Japan

companies.name: Aisin (Toyota Group)
companies.what: Major manufacturer of gas-engine heat pump systems alongside Yanmar in the Japanese GHP duopoly
companies.signal: Decades-old commercial GHP line

companies.name: Tecogen
companies.what: US maker of natural-gas engine-driven chillers/heat pumps and CHP for buildings with constrained electric service
companies.signal: NYSE American: TGEN; niche but persistent installed base

variations.white_space: Sparse by design: at COP ~1.4 on fossil fuel versus 3-4 electric, the niche shrinks as grids decarbonize — it remains credible only where gas/propane infrastructure is sunk and electric capacity is scarce (rural propane markets, demand-constrained urban feeders), so few entrants is rational rather than an opportunity gap.

variations.name: Solid-state & caloric heating/cooling (thermoelectric, elastocaloric, magnetocaloric, barocaloric, thermoacoustic)
variations.description: Replaces the vapor-compression cycle with solid refrigerants or acoustic/semiconductor effects — zero F-gases, no compressor wear, and theoretically higher efficiency — but power density and cost still trail compressors, so F-gas regulation is the commercial wedge.

companies.name: Phononic
companies.what: Thermoelectric cooling chips shipping commercially in optical transceivers, cold-chain, and data-center niches — the only solid-state player with volume products, though not yet space conditioning
companies.signal: Commercial products shipping; profiled by RMI in 2025 as a leading low-emission cooling player

companies.name: Exergyn
companies.what: Dublin company building shape-memory-alloy elastocaloric cores intended to slot into OEM heat pumps and chillers in place of compressors
companies.signal: ~$64M raised; Carrier Ventures investment reportedly valuing it above €200M

companies.name: Pascal
companies.what: Harvard spinout (Cambridge, MA) using metal-halide perovskite barocaloric solid refrigerants that work at far lower pressures than prior barocaloric materials
companies.signal: $8M seed May 2024 led by Engine Ventures with Khosla Ventures

companies.name: Barocal
companies.what: University of Cambridge (UK) spinout commercializing barocaloric organic crystals for refrigerant-free cooling, now extending into heat pumps
companies.signal: €8.5M seed May 2026; named a 'Race to First' solid-state cooling frontrunner

companies.name: Magnotherm
companies.what: TU Darmstadt spinout building magnetocaloric coolers — pilot beverage coolers today, heat pumps on the roadmap, plus a 2025 magnetic-cooling hydrogen-liquefaction demo with HZDR
companies.signal: €6.3M seed (2023) plus EU grants; pilot units delivered; claims 15% efficiency edge over propane coolers

companies.name: BlueHeart Energy
companies.what: Dutch thermoacoustic 'engine' using helium and sound waves as the heat-pump core, supplied to HVAC OEMs rather than sold direct
companies.signal: Strategic investment from compressor giant Copeland (Apr 2025); OEM availability targeted Q1 2027

companies.name: Equium
companies.what: French thermoacoustic heat-pump core developer pursuing the same OEM-component model as BlueHeart
companies.signal: ~$6.6M raised through a small Series B (Feb 2024)

variations.white_space: Crowded with startups but empty of shipped space-conditioning products — specific cooling power, cyclic fatigue, and cost per kW all still lose to a $300 rotary compressor; the realistic wedge is F-gas phase-down niches (refrigeration, dehumidification) before whole-building HVAC.

variations.name: Ultra-efficient AC & dehumidification (desiccant/evaporative hybrids) + high-efficiency HVAC components
variations.description: Splits humidity removal from sensible cooling using liquid or solid desiccants and advanced evaporative stages — cutting AC electricity 30-90% and shaving peak demand — while next-gen motors and oil-free compressors squeeze the remaining watts out of conventional systems; cooling is the fastest-growing electricity end use on earth.

companies.name: Blue Frontier
companies.what: Liquid-desiccant air conditioner with built-in thermochemical energy storage, cutting cooling electricity ~45-90% and peak draw >90% by recharging desiccant off-peak
companies.signal: $20M Series A led by Breakthrough Energy Ventures; 2025 R&D 100 Award; first Florida commercial installs with trials nearly halving cooling bills

companies.name: AirJoule Technologies (formerly Montana Technologies)
companies.what: Sorbent-contactor 'AirJoule Core' for industrial dehumidification and atmospheric water harvesting (up to 250 L/day), claiming up to 80% energy savings versus desiccant wheels; 50/50 JV with GE Vernova
companies.signal: NASDAQ: AIRJ via 2024 SPAC; still pre-revenue per FY2025 10-K — commercialization risk explicit

companies.name: Mojave Energy Systems
companies.what: ArctiDry liquid-desiccant dedicated outdoor air system (DOAS) for commercial buildings, manufactured in Anderson, South Carolina
companies.signal: $9.5M Series A Dec 2024 (Fifth Wall, At One Ventures); 19 sales-rep firms added in a year; DOE manufacturing scale-up support

companies.name: Transaera
companies.what: MIT spinout coating heat exchangers with metal-organic-framework (MOF) sorbents so standard HVAC can strip humidity with far less energy
companies.signal: $8.2M seed-2 (Nov 2024) + $2.3M DOE grants; multi-year Amazon warehouse deal after a Houston pilot; underlying MOF chemistry won the 2025 Nobel Prize

companies.name: Danfoss
companies.what: Turbocor oil-free magnetic-bearing centrifugal compressors — the enabling component behind the world's most efficient chillers
companies.signal: De-facto standard in high-efficiency chiller retrofits

companies.name: Copeland
companies.what: World's largest compressor maker (ex-Emerson Climate, Blackstone-majority) driving variable-speed scroll adoption and placing strategic bets on novel cycles (BlueHeart investment)
companies.signal: ~$5B revenue; 2025 strategic investment in thermoacoustics

companies.name: Infinitum
companies.what: Axial-flux motors with printed-circuit-board stators for HVAC fans and air handlers — ~50% smaller/lighter with integrated drive
companies.signal: $185M Series E (2023, led by Just Climate); shipping into commercial HVAC OEMs

companies.name: Turntide Technologies
companies.what: Switched-reluctance 'smart motor' retrofits for HVAC that failed to scale in buildings — sold its building-automation division to BrainBox AI (May 2024) and pivoted to off-highway/industrial electrification after 2022-23 layoffs
companies.signal: Raised >$400M at peak; exit from building HVAC is cautionary evidence for component-only plays

variations.white_space: A prior liquid-desiccant wave already died on cost and maintenance (Advantix bankrupt mid-2010s; 7AC's tech absorbed by Emerson in 2019), and Turntide's retreat shows components need OEM channels — the open ground is humid-climate DOAS, grid-interactive cooling with built-in storage, and proving desiccant O&M economics over multi-year fleets.
